keyFindings.description: dropsUnselectedAskBlock reads tr.mapping.mapResult(at, 1).deletedAfter, which prosemirror-transform 1.12.1 also sets for a pure insertion at `at` (StepMap._map, dist/index.js:118). An edit that deletes nothing is refused: in happy-dom an insertion into the middle or start of an unselected option, and a drop there. In Chromium against the real server (deep-review probe U1), typing x in the second list, clicking into the question and pressing Ctrl+Z leaves '* Option xA' stored; prosemirror-history's undo is refused (meta history$) and the keystroke is consumed. Round 3's code applied all of these.

refuseAskContentEdit protects options by label only and quotedLabels quotes labels cut at 80 runes. Following the refusal deletes a collaborator's text: Go probe, block '- Defer: Wait a week', edit [Ship, Hold, {Label: Defer}] -> nil, 'Wait a week' gone; a collaborator's second list '* Ship: Only on Fridays' is deleted by [Ship, Hold]; a long label is cut so it cannot be echoed back. The Changed fragment and packages/envoy/AGENTS.md:2180-2184 claim the opposite.

The filter skips every node that is not text (:227), so an unselected image-only paragraph of a broken ask is dropped without a refusal (code-quality probe d6), while the Fixed fragment says an edit is refused when it would delete any of a list or paragraph the person did not select.
